You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Landon Stein. Mortician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Contract Quill, Beat-up Paperback, Dispatcher's headset, Photo album, Brass Locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last nigh

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Grayson Krawczyk. Barber. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dead Phone, Seed packet, Field suture kit, Photo album, Dispatcher's headset. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 2). Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 2). You read the day's water — temperature, clarity, current — and set your effort where the fish already are. Nets come up heavier.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 6 skills from your past — check your Journal.
